Writing Dutch correctly and flawlessly is no rocket science, as long as you know the tricks of the trade. This course is packed with practically applicable background knowledge, tips and tools to better write in Dutch. With this training, technical writers can improve and refresh their knowledge of the Dutch language. They also learn to write coherently and, above all, in a target-oriented way. Topics: - Sharpen your writing skills: grammar, rules and style; - Active writing - Eliminating passive voice for clearer communication.;; - Target your audience through good writing: register and specific characteristics; - Editorial skills and a critical language attitude - Developing a critical language approach for consistency and clarity. Course Material: Writing guide: - Presentation with key writing principles.;; - Practical language tools for everyday use; - Theory and detailed exercises available as handouts. Results: 
After completing the workshop, the trainee will have greatly improved his or her knowledge of the Dutch language and can stay clear of common or careless mistakes. Not only will the trainee write more effectively and with greater confidence, but he or she will also learn to convert complex technical information into a user-friendly manual. 
The trainee demonstrates a good understanding of language register and how to use it correctly. You will learn to read the work of others as well as your own from a critical and respectful perspective. Additional Information:

Looking for a stable, well-paid job in production where you can work with your hands and make a real impact? Join MGG in Tegelen as a Production Worker (Grinder) and become an essential part of the manufacturing process. In this role, you will grind, finish, and inspect aluminum products to ensure they meet the highest quality standards. This is a physically active position in a 3-shift system, including night shifts, making it ideal for people who enjoy practical, hands-on work and are not afraid of a challenge. Wie zoeken we? Live near Tegelen and have your own accommodation and transport Have experience working in a 3-shift system (or at least night shifts) Speak English, German, or Dutch Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour including allowances (see below how it is calculated) Full-time job of 37,5 hours per week in 3 shifts Travel allowance Long-term, stable work Chance of a permanent contract in the future Opportunity to develop your technical skills How is the salary calculated? The basic hourly wage is €16.06. You will receive a 120% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving This job is perfect for you if you like hands-on work that keeps you active during your shift. Your workday will consist of: Grinding and finishing aluminum products Working with tools and machines Loading products into machines and robots Checking product quality It's a plus if you have worked in metal of construction or other production areas, but technical experience is not required. You will work in a 3-shift system that consists of the following working hours: 5:45 AM – 1:45 PM, 1:45 PM – 9:45 PM, 9:45 PM – 5:45 AM. Apply now and become part of the team at MGG in Tegelen!
